description: A multi-agent research swarm built on ElizaOS for autonomous crypto market analysis, with BTC-centric and altcoin specialists, Slack integration, and recursive self-improvement features.

userStories.title: Set up core project structure and monorepo
userStories.description: Initialize the monorepo with Bun and Turbo, including src/ directory structure for index.ts, coordinator.ts, specialists/, character.ts, frontend/, plugins/, and utils/.
acceptanceCriteria: Monorepo configured with turbo.json and package.json
Build scripts (build.ts, start-server.ts) functional
Vite and Tailwind configs set up
Basic file structure matches the provided tree
bun install and bun run build succeed without errors

userStories.title: Implement swarm coordinator
userStories.description: Develop coordinator.ts for routing queries, aggregating outputs, scheduling tasks, regime synthesis, and dynamic agent loading from static and Postgres sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Coordinator handles query routing to appropriate specialists
Aggregation logic combines outputs into structured JSON
Scheduling supports daily/periodic tasks
Dynamic loading pulls from dynamic_specialists table
Unit tests cover basic routing and synthesis scenarios

userStories.title: Create BTC-centric specialists
userStories.description: Implement 11 BTC-centric specialists in specialists/ with system prompts, tools, and channel configs, integrating data plugins like CoinGecko, DeFiLlama, etc.
acceptanceCriteria: Each specialist has name, channel, system_prompt, tools, and schedule
Prompts cover 33 refined templates distributed across specialists
Tools call relevant plugins (e.g., onChainHealthSpecialist.ts uses CryptoQuant, Glassnode)
Specialists output structured JSON for aggregator
regimeAggregatorSpecialist.ts synthesizes all BTC outputs

userStories.title: Create altcoin research specialists
userStories.description: Implement 8 altcoin specialists with qualitative prompts, heavy tool calling for web/X search, and integration with coordinator.
acceptanceCriteria: Each has system_prompt for discovery-oriented tasks
Tools include web_search and planned x_keyword_search
Fallback to site:x.com in web_search until plugin-x-search ready
Outputs feed into regimeAggregator for synthesis
Test autonomy with mock tool responses

userStories.title: Implement meta/self-improvement specialist
userStories.description: Develop metaEngineerSpecialist.ts for reflection, gap detection, and spawning, including spawn tools and Postgres integration.
acceptanceCriteria: System prompt for monitoring swarm and identifying gaps
Tools: spawn_temporary_subagent and spawn_persistent_specialist
Handlers in utils/ for in-memory temp agents and proposal posting
